landing.heroTitle: Leave the meeting knowing what happens next.
landing.heroSub: MoleSkill transcribes the recording, creates a concise summary and pulls out decisions and action items with owners and due dates. Built for small teams that need to keep their commitments clear.
landing.demoSummary: The team agreed to launch the beta on November 3 and split the prep work.

demoTasks.t: Check payments on the test environment

landing.whySub: A general chatbot answers questions. MoleSkill turns a conversation into data you can work with.

rows.a: A long text you have to reread
rows.b: Summary, decisions and tasks in separate blocks

rows.a: You copy them into a tracker by hand
rows.b: Owner and due date come from the conversation, and tasks can be checked off
Ask questions across all your past meetings at once
The Windows app records both the other participants and you
Recordings are private: you only see your own meetings

steps.d: Upload an audio file or record the meeting through your browser microphone.
Speech becomes text, then decisions and tasks are pulled out.
Summary, decisions and dated tasks appear in your list.

feats.d: Speech is recognized and minutes are written in the language of the call.
Phrases like "on Friday" become actual dates, and overdue work stands out.
Ask "what did we decide about the budget?" and get an answer from your own minutes.
The Windows app records calls, the browser records your microphone. Android is coming.
Copy the minutes in one click, and rerun a failed analysis.
Follows your system or switches by hand.

faq.q: How do I add a Zoom or Teams meeting?
faq.a: Upload the meeting's audio recording. Browser recording captures your microphone, so use the file from your conferencing app for a call.
MP3, M4A, WAV, WEBM and other audio files up to 15 MB.
Recordings are kept in private storage and available to workspace members according to their roles. Audio is sent to Groq for transcription and analysis.
Free for now while the project is in development.
Only record with the consent of everyone taking part.
